title: Nobody Wanted This Rooftop… Until Now 😳
short_title: Nobody Wanted This Rooftop… Until Now 😳
caption: From forgotten to beautiful ✨ What would you add to this rooftop? 👉 Share with a friend, subscribe for a new makeover every day, and comment if you want more like this!
narration: This might be the worst rooftop we've seen. Bit by bit, the crew swept away years of trash, pressure-washed the old concrete, and laid a warm wooden deck. What a transformation. If you loved this, share it with a friend and subscribe for more. And let me know in the comments if you want more videos like this.
